name: New screen design reviewer
why: Checks each new screen against your own design rules and ranks fixes, a repeatable version of the before-and-after review.

name: Write design rules, check colours and hand developers a spec
why: Runs from design rules to contrast-checked colours to a developer spec, the same path as the screen design to handoff workflow.

name: Borrow a look you like and plan a readable page
why: Turns designs a client likes into a grid and type plan with checked colours, a good start before setting foundations.

name: Landing page design planner
why: Plans three design directions from page copy and brand assets with a build brief, for marketing pages rather than app screens.

name: Give developers a complete component brief
why: Specifies one component's variants, states and tokens for build, a deeper version of the states matrix prompt.

name: Design handoff completeness assistant
why: Finds missing states and variants in a changed component before developers start.

name: Layout default breaker
why: Finds layout choices inherited from a template and offers hand-made alternatives, useful when a screen looks generic.

name: Mood colour palette planner
why: Builds a small palette where each colour has one job, a useful input before naming colour roles.

name: Quarterly accessibility keeper
why: Rechecks accessibility gaps and contrast each quarter, a follow-up to the contrast and dark mode check.

name: Check a translated interface still makes sense
why: Flags translated text that may not fit the layout, so screen specs can plan for longer strings.
